The [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] '''SU-40 airspeeder''' was an unarmed, high-performance sporting craft, and acted as the airspeeder equivalent of the [[AV-21 Landspeeder|AV-21 landspeeder]].<ref name="Stay on Target" /> It was lightweight, featuring a dart-like fuselage with a two-person cockpit and polarized bubble canopy. It also featured short wings and a single [[IN-780 supercharged ion turbofan engine]] with vectoring thrust nozzles. The engine was supported by altitude thrusters, and could reach speeds comparable to a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]. The airspeeders were custom-built for their owners, making them extremely rare and considerably expensive, and were primarily sold only in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The craft sacrificed comfort and safety for speed and handling. The militarized [[SU-42RS Flashblind Aerial Reconnaissance Airspeeder/Legends|SU-42RS Flashblind]] was built around the baseline SU-40 model.

==Behind the scenes==
The SU-40 was created for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].
